description: Local (app-origin) capability for the main window — the connection screen (which engine to talk to). core:default UI operations plus the connection-screen commands in `allow-setup-commands` (load_connection, connect, open_settings_app, open_manual). Configuration and API keys live in the SEPARATE settings app; nothing sensitive crosses this boundary. No remote grant: the loopback dashboard's narrower access is in the `dashboard` capability. No shell, arbitrary filesystem, http, dialog, or autostart.
